findings.label: EmployeesImportResult is dead code
findings.detail: The class exists at app/Imports/EmployeesImportResult.php but is never imported or instantiated. ListEmployees reads errors directly from $import->getErrors(). Either wire it into the import flow or delete the file.

findings.label: WithHeadings spec mismatch
findings.detail: The review criteria specifies WithHeadings for EmployeesImport, but WithHeadings is an export interface. WithHeadingRow (what the code implements) is the correct interface for reading header-keyed rows. Code is correct; spec was wrong.

findings.label: Silent QR failure produces PDFs without QR code and no log
findings.detail: If QrCode::generate() throws, the catch block swallows the exception with no Log::warning(). PDFs will render without QR codes and there will be no log trace. Add Log::warning() in the catch block.

findings.label: Arabic day-word ordering for 21-99
findings.detail: The combined tens+ones path in daysToArabicWords() produces 'يوم واحد وعشرون' (ones before tens) rather than the standard Arabic 'واحد وعشرون يوماً'. Cosmetic only, not functional.
